title: Missing the Forest for the Trees in Taiwan’s Defense Preparations
gist: K. Tristan Tang argues that debate over Taiwan's Han Kuang exercises and procurement misses the core question of how Taiwan intends to fight, noting a shift to an erosion strategy, northern army reinforcement, nearly a month of large-scale exercises in 2026, and a significant navy expansion.

insights.claim: The author argues the most core issue in Taiwan's defense—how exactly its military may fight—has received far less discussion than Han Kuang exercise changes and equipment procurement.
insights.speaker: K. Tristan Tang
insights.so_what: Assessing Taiwan's deterrence requires looking at doctrine, not just arms purchases.
insights.quote: the most core issue seems to have received much less discussion: how exactly the Taiwan military may fight

insights.claim: Taiwan has moved from defeating the enemy on the opposite shore or a decisive littoral battle toward an erosion strategy and sustained operations.
insights.speaker: K. Tristan Tang
insights.so_what: An attritional, sustained-operations doctrine implies a longer conflict scenario with prolonged trade disruption.
insights.quote: Taiwan has moved from its past concepts of defeating the enemy on the opposite shore or seeking a decisive battle in the littoral area to actually carrying out an erosion strategy and sustained operations
insights.locator: Taiwan has moved from its past

insights.claim: Taiwan has continued strengthening the army's active-duty combat power in the northern region to build a layered defensive network and regional force superiority.
insights.speaker: K. Tristan Tang
insights.so_what: Signals where Taiwan expects the main axis of attack and where defense spending concentrates.
insights.locator: Taiwan has moved from its past

insights.claim: The cumulative duration of Taiwan's large-scale military exercises in 2026 has already reached nearly one month.
insights.speaker: K. Tristan Tang
insights.so_what: Longer exercises indicate rising readiness and greater mobilization costs.
insights.quote: the cumulative duration of large-scale exercises in 2026 has already accumulated to nearly one month

insights.claim: Taiwan's navy has expanded significantly in recent years, a development the author says many have noticed but not appreciated.
insights.speaker: K. Tristan Tang
insights.so_what: Naval build-up may create demand for shipbuilding and naval systems and alter blockade calculus.
insights.quote: the significant expansion of Taiwan’s navy in recent years
